meta.title: 三色光混色实验：数码影像的色彩原理
meta.title_en: RGB Light Mixing: The Color Science of Digital Imaging

scenes.title_en: The three-light experiment in a dark room
scenes.context: 讲者搭建设备：关掉所有灯，用红绿蓝三盏灯做混色实验。
sentences: 想象一下在一个伸手不见五指的夜里，把房间内所有灯光全部关闭。
Imagine a pitch-black night where every light in the room is switched off.
伸手不见五指：pitch-black
此时我们打开一个红色的灯光，再打开一个绿色的灯光，再打开一个蓝色的灯光。
Now turn on a red light, then a green one, then a blue one.
打开灯光：turn on the light
当红色灯光与绿色混合在一起就有了黄色。
Mix the red light with the green and you get yellow.
混合在一起：mix together
paraphrase: 关灯→让颜色从纯光开始
Darkness first, so color starts purely from light.
Mixing pairs of primaries creates new colors.
scenes.speak: Imagine a pitch-black night where every light in the room is switched off. Now turn on a red light, then a green one, then a blue one. Mix the red light with the green and you get yellow.

scenes.title_en: Mixing, dimming, and how images are made
scenes.context: 讲者用强度调节开关演示比例混色，并引出数码照片的成像原理。
sentences: 通过这三种颜色灯光不同比例的变化，能混合出人眼可以看到的所有颜色。
By varying the ratio of these three lights, you can produce every color the human eye can see.
不同比例：varying the ratio
假如这不是一个圆形而是一个正方形，再假如我们有很多这样的正方形排列在一起。
What if this weren't a circle but a square — and what if we lined up thousands of these squares?
排列在一起：line them up
再把它们缩小、缩小、再缩小，这就是数码时代彩色照片的成像原理。
Shrink them again and again, and that's how digital color photos are made.
成像原理：how digital photos are made
paraphrase: 比例=调色→一切颜色皆可混合
Ratios are the dial — any color can be mixed.
色块缩小成像素→数码成像
Tiny colored squares are pixels; that's digital imaging.
scenes.speak: By varying the ratio of these three lights, you can produce every color the human eye can see. What if this weren't a circle but a square — and what if we lined up thousands of these squares? Shrink them again and again, and that's how digital color photos are made.

scenes.title_cn: 色彩三属性与后期调色
scenes.title_en: The three attributes of color and editing
scenes.context: 讲者定义色相、饱和度、明度三大属性，并演示后期调色的应用。
sentences: 如果你想把一个物体的颜色改变成别的颜色，只需要修改它的色相即可。
To change an object's color to something else, just adjust its hue.
修改色相：adjust its hue
饱和度表示的是颜色的鲜艳程度，明度表示的是颜色的深浅程度。
Saturation describes how vivid a color is, and lightness describes how light or dark it is.
鲜艳程度：how vivid
可以通过后期调色软件快速地调水果的颜色、调衣服的颜色、调人物皮肤的颜色，总之万物皆可调。
With editing software, you can quickly recolor fruit, clothing, and skin — in short, anything can be recolored.
万物皆可调：anything can be recolored
paraphrase: 三属性=调色的三个旋钮
Hue, saturation, and lightness are the three dials of color.
Understand the attributes, and anything can be recolored.
scenes.speak: To change an object's color to something else, just adjust its hue. Saturation describes how vivid a color is, and lightness describes how light or dark it is. With editing software, you can quickly recolor fruit, clothing, and skin — in short, anything can be recolored.

practice: Turn off every light so we start from pure darkness.
Mix red and green light and you get yellow.
Tiny colored squares make up digital photos.
Adjust hue, saturation, or lightness to change a color.
pitfalls: ✓ 地道说法：Hue describes what the color looks like.
hue 直接表达「色相」，避免直译。
✕ 直译腔：The brightness degree of the color.
✓ 地道说法：Lightness describes how light or dark a color is.
light or dark 比 brightness degree 更口语。
✕ 直译腔：Mix red and blue lights get magenta.
✓ 地道说法：Red light mixed with blue gives you magenta.
✓ 地道说法：Anything can be recolored.
shifts: 颜色是天生的，只能接受
三色光按比例可混合出所有颜色
调色靠色相、饱和度、明度三大属性
照片=无数彩色像素的排列
